answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to post a refundable stake tied to a unique hardware attestation, like a factory-burned pigment signature no two chips share. Spinning up a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand stakes and a thousand devices, not a thousand free usernames. Honest agents earn the stake back in fees over time, while a detected fake forfeits it — like an island with a single jetty: every arrival is inspected at the same narrow gate, and a clone that cannot pay the toll is turned away before it can trade.
